data.title: 结城明日奈 · 街角屋檐的西装外套共披·「靠近一点……这样就不会淋湿了」
data.description: 【突降夏日阵雨的街角便利店屋檐下】夏日骤雨如注，雨水顺着蓝色遮雨棚边缘串成透明水帘。躲避暴雨的亚丝娜与你紧紧依偎在狭小的屋檐下，两人合披着你的深色校服外套。她双手拽着外套前襟，侧脸轻轻贴在你的肩膀上，呼吸着近在咫尺的清冽雨水与彼此的气息，心跳加速。
data.location: 街角复古商店紧凑的避雨屋檐下
data.action: 与你并肩依偎在屋檐下合披外套，双手轻捏外套边缘，侧脸微靠着你的手臂，睫毛轻颤
data.lighting: 雨丝反射的阴翳天光与便利店透出的纯白日光灯暖影
data.camera: medium close-up, cozy cramped space framing, rain curtain foreground depth
data.promptProse: Asuna shelters shoulder-close to her companion beneath the convenience store's narrow blue awning, both sharing his dark jacket over their school clothes. She holds its front edges and rests her cheek on his shoulder. The cramped close view keeps falling water beyond the awning rim in the foreground. Overcast daylight reflects on wet hair, while white shop lighting illuminates her grey blazer and leaves a sheltered shadow against the wall.
